subject: Request: temporary grace period for marketplace listing fee — evidence attached
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing fee - ask for short grace period and evidence collection

Vanessa / Karthik —

Quick heads up: AWS Partner Ops flagged our Q2 listing fee as overdue (they tie the fee to a consumption milestone for the marketplace listing). Renewal paperwork from procurement missed a small clause and the invoice posted today. Partner Ops is open to a one-month grace period while we provide supporting documents, but they need a consolidated evidence package by next week.

Can you help with two things: 1) Vanessa, can you draft a short ask to AWS outlining the request for a 30-day grace period and the timeline for delivery? Keep it operational and concise (they prefer bullets). 2) Karthik, please pull the signed SOW and the most recent invoice/tax docs (I think we have the invoice in Finance Drive). I attached the SOC2 report and the draft SOW I have.

Attachments: SOC2_report_redwood_2027.pdf (pdf), marketplace_listing_sow.docx (docx)

Goal: get AWS to confirm extension so we don't get delisted or lose credits while Legal finalizes the amended clause.

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Operations (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0189
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing fee - ask for short grace period and evidence collection

Perfect — drafting now. Suggested bullets to AWS (I can paste this into an outbound email):

- Request: 30-day grace period to reconcile invoicing and provide supporting documentation; no changes to listing status during the period.
- Evidence we will provide by 17 May: signed SOW, latest invoice (Q1 2028), SOC 2 report, and an attestation from Finance confirming no outstanding dispute.
- Why: administrative clause omission (section on invoice timing) — not a product/usage issue.
- Proposed contact for verification: Karthik Iyer (Finance lead) and Neha Kapoor (Partner Ops).

Karthik — can you confirm you can produce the invoice + finance attestation by EOD Monday (13 May)? If not, call me and we'll escalate to Procurement.

I'll polish and send to mp-ops@aws.amazon.com; cc Legal if warranted.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marketplace Partner Ops <mp-ops@aws.amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: temporary grace period for marketplace listing fee — evidence attached

Hello mp-ops team,

Thanks for the flag earlier this week. We reviewed the posting and believe this is an administrative mismatch tied to the listing SOW timing rather than a consumption/usage dispute. We are requesting a one-month (30-day) grace period while we deliver supporting documentation.

What we will provide by 17 May (UTC):
- Signed SOW for the AWS Marketplace listing (marketplace_listing_sow.docx)
- Invoice: aws_invoice_q1_2028.pdf (attached)
- SOC2 report: SOC2_report_redwood_2027.pdf (attached)
- Finance attestation: short email from our Finance lead confirming no disputed charges (we will provide this as a PDF).

Why we ask: an internal sign-off on an amendment to the listing clause slipped during contract renewals; granting a short grace period will prevent delisting and preserve co-sell credits for our mutual customers.

Related: HubSpot opportunity DEAL-8421 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/8421). If DocuSign is required for an amendment, please share the link and we'll expedite.

Attachments: aws_invoice_q1_2028.pdf (pdf), marketplace_listing_sow.docx (docx), SOC2_report_redwood_2027.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate your help —
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Operations (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Marketplace Partner Ops <mp-ops@aws.amazon.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary grace period for marketplace listing fee — evidence attached

Thanks Neha —

We received the package and have started review. We can provisionally approve a 30-day administrative extension, pending validation of the documents listed. Two quick asks to close this:

1) Finance attestation: please provide a signed PDF from your Finance director (name and title) confirming the invoice is being processed and there is no underlying dispute. The attestation should include the invoice number and payment ETA.
2) Legal entity confirmation: we need a one-page confirmation showing the legal entity that signed the original listing SOW (company name and EIN or equivalent). This can be a redacted W-9 or similar.

Once we have those two items we will mark the listing as in good standing for 30 days and suspend any enforcement actions. Please reply to this thread with the files or share a DocuSign link if needed.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Marketplace Partner Ops — AWS
mp-ops@aws.amazon.com
